### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

## Transfer

---


[Bi-entity Action Types](https://origins.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types/bientity_action_types/)

Transfers a package of powers between the __actor__ and __target__ entities.

Type ID: `sync:transfer`

---

### Examples

```json
{
    "type": "sync:transfer",
    "mode": "steal",
    "strip_from_donor": true,
    "actor_action": {
        "type": "apoli:play_sound",
        "sound": "minecraft:entity.enderman.teleport"
    }
}
```
Steals all powers from the target and removes them from the target.

```json
{
    "type": "sync:transfer",
    "mode": "give",
    "target_action": {
        "type": "apoli:play_sound",
        "sound": "minecraft:block.enchantment_table.use"
    }
}
```
Returns the actor's currently selected stolen package to the target.

```json
{
    "type": "sync:transfer",
    "mode": "auto",
    "source": "my_datapack:origin_powers"
}
```
Steals or gives (based on current mode) powers from the `my_datapack:origin_powers` source only.

x-intellij-html-description:
title: Transfer (Bi-entity Action) date: 2024-01-07

Transfer

Bi-entity Action Types

Transfers a package of powers between the actor and target entities.

Type ID: sync:transfer

Fields

Field Type Default Description
mode String "steal" Transfer direction. "steal" takes powers from target to actor. "give" returns the actor's selected stolen package to the target. "auto" reads the actor's current mode
source Identifier optional When stealing, only powers from this specific source are taken. Omit to steal from all sources
transfer_source Identifier sync:transferred The source identifier under which stolen powers are granted to the actor
strip_from_donor Boolean true If true, powers are removed from the donor after being transferred
actor_action Entity Action optional Action executed on the actor after the transfer completes
target_action Entity Action optional Action executed on the target after the transfer completes

Notes

  • In steal mode, all top-level powers from the target (or the specified source) are registered as a "stolen package" on the actor and granted under transfer_source.
  • In give mode, the actor returns the currently selected stolen package (see Cycle Stolen Power) to the target. If strip_from_donor is true, the package is removed from the actor's inventory.
  • Sub-powers (children of a multiple power) are excluded from transfer (only top-level power types are moved).
  • "auto" mode reads the actor's current steal/give state set by Toggle Transfer Mode.

Examples

{
    "type": "sync:transfer",
    "mode": "steal",
    "strip_from_donor": true,
    "actor_action": {
        "type": "apoli:play_sound",
        "sound": "minecraft:entity.enderman.teleport"
    }
}

Steals all powers from the target and removes them from the target.

{
    "type": "sync:transfer",
    "mode": "give",
    "target_action": {
        "type": "apoli:play_sound",
        "sound": "minecraft:block.enchantment_table.use"
    }
}

Returns the actor's currently selected stolen package to the target.

{
    "type": "sync:transfer",
    "mode": "auto",
    "source": "my_datapack:origin_powers"
}

Steals or gives (based on current mode) powers from the my_datapack:origin_powers source only.
